title: Two-Step Cage
setup: Black's king on c8 still has three squares. Your king already holds c7 and d7, and your queen is far away on h5.
hint: Any check here lets the king out. Take its squares away quietly and leave it exactly one move.
explanation:
## The Idea

Checking first lets the king run. {{Qb5}} gives no check at all: it takes the whole b-file, so b8 and b7 are gone, and your king on d6 already holds c7 and d7.

Black has one legal move, {{Kd8}}, and it walks into {{Qb8#}}. The queen covers the eighth rank, your king covers the seventh, and the black king has nowhere left. {{Qd7#}} mates just as well.
